items.text: ETR Sunday injury report lists Puka Nacua as QUESTIONABLE (calf). McVay: took majority of Thursday practice, felt lack of power/explosion, will test pregame.
items.why: Calf injury; majority practice but pregame test
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT massive TE funnel and hierarchy shift for Rams
items.opportunity: Tyler Higbee lead targets if out; multi-TE sets

items.text: ETR lists Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle). Status crucial for DFS slate.
items.implication: If active major upgrade for Ravens skill; if OUT backups elevated

items.text: ETR lists Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad). Berry: if plays vs MIA goes right into lineup despite Stephania Bell caution.
items.implication: If ACTIVE start; if OUT Braelon Allen heavy workload
items.opportunity: Allen snap/attempt share high in absences

items.text: Schefter: Players ruled OUT include Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Brian Robinson, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, David Montgomery, Jeremiyah Love, Rashee Rice, Zach Charbonnet, Davante Adams (among others).
items.implication: Clear sits; open opportunities for teammates/handcuffs
items.opportunity: SF WR void to Kittle/CMC; ATL Bijan full; SEA Wilson/others; ARI Allgeier; etc.

items.text: Rapoport: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan confirmed WR Mike Evans (Achilles) is OUT vs Falcons.
items.implication: SF WR corps depleted; Kittle/CMC funnel
items.opportunity: George Kittle primary; CMC more slot

items.text: Levitan: If Puka Nacua can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen. Adams already long-term out.
items.why: Calf uncertainty + Adams IR hamstring 6-10 wks; prior Puka-out TE share 37%
items.opportunity: TE target share spike; Higbee lead

items.text: Levitan: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring). 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB catches/TDs. Sweet setup for Bijan Robinson full workload vs SF.
items.why: BRob OUT + SF soft vs RBs (White/Holani/Harvey/Love data)
items.implication: Bijan RB1 lock with receiving upside

items.text: Levitan: George Kittle will go nuts (scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt: Evans/Deebo OUT). Rarely buy RB-as-WR but tempted on CMC more slot with Kaelon Black/WR injuries; CMC smiled at question.
items.why: WR injuries create funnel; National TE Day irrelevant historically
items.implication: Kittle TE1 elite; CMC receiving boost possible
items.conflict: Rarely buy RB-WR but situation dire

items.text: Rapoport: Bears TE Cole Kmet to IR with season-ending knee injury per coach Ben Johnson.
Rapoport: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle/high-ankle) ruled OUT by coach Mike LaFleur; misses another game.
Berry Loves: A.J. Brown (97% routes/33% TS buy even after drops), DeVonta Smith, Tucker Kraft, Matthew Golden @DET (deep targets vs soft Lions). Also Loveland 30% TS/19.2 PPR w/ Caleb return.
items.why: Usage (AJB routes/TS), matchups (Lions soft, Bears yards), Caleb juice for Loveland

items.text: Berry Loves RBs: Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving (workloads + friendly matchups). Saquon if active vs DAL right back in lineups. Hates: Josh Jacobs (layoff workload Q), Odunze, Downs, Kelce.
items.why: Volume + DvP for loves; Jacobs post-layoff, tough spots for hates

items.text: Levitan: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps over last three weeks. Downgrade.
Levitan: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet IR season-ending may reduce 2/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.implication: Higher route share/WR3-flex upside with Caleb
